prompt.en: Which two provinces have their own provincial police forces?
prompt.fr: Quelles deux provinces ont leur propre corps de police provincial?

explanation.en: Ontario and Quebec each run a police force for the whole province.
explanation.fr: L'Ontario et le Québec ont chacun un corps de police pour l'ensemble de la province.

source.quote: There are different types of police in Canada. There are provincial police forces in Ontario and Quebec and municipal police departments in all provinces.
